subject: Evidence plan: SCIM delta sync logs + SAML metadata & admin role mapping
messages:
From: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@audit-consult.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: security_ops@nephrosys.com
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2/CAIQ follow-up: SCIM delta syncs & SAML admin role proof

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for taking our intake call last week. NephroSys needs a compact evidence package for their SOC 2 readiness review and has the following asks around Access Control / IAM:

- Recent SCIM provisioning change log (delta syncs) covering Aug-Nov 2025 (CSV preferred)
- Current SAML metadata (IdP/SP) and a screenshot of the IdP admin console showing the Redwood app config
- RBAC role-to-permission mapping and a short attestation that admin roles are limited to scoped job titles
- Confirmation of least-privilege process for service accounts (who owns, rotation cadence)

Can you confirm what you can provide and an ETA (ideally within 3 business days)? If easier, a short plan + Drive link is fine.

Morgan
Morgan Lee
Senior SOC2 Auditor, Audit Consult

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@audit-consult.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2/CAIQ follow-up: SCIM delta syncs & SAML admin role proof

Hi Morgan — thanks for the clear list.

High-level plan (ETA = close of day Wed, Nov 5):
1) SCIM delta CSV: export from provisioning pipeline covering 2025-08-01 through 2025-11-02 (we will redact PII per NephroSys rules)
2) SAML metadata + IdP screenshots: current saml_metadata_20251103.xml + 2 admin console screenshots showing app assignment + ACS URL
3) RBAC mapping: annotated PDF mapping roles -> permissions, plus a short attestation paragraph from Rishi
4) Service account process: short doc with owner, rotation cadence, and KMS integration note

I will upload to a shared Drive folder and send you a link. Rishi — can you assemble the exports and the annotated RBAC mapping? Laura, looping you for compliance signoff on redaction rules.

-Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 11:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: SCIM exports and RBAC mapping (attachments)

Folks — assembling the requested items. Attachment list below; putting notes inline for later redaction before sharing with external: 

Attachments included:
- scim_delta_2025Q3.csv (contains: timestamp, operation, target_user_id, target_email*, source, actor_id)
- saml_metadata_20251103.xml (current SP metadata)
- rbac_role_mapping_annotated.pdf (role, permission, example guard rails)
- idp_screenshots_20251103.zip (2 PNGs: idp_assignment.png, app_settings.png)

Notes:
- scim export includes target_email in cleartext; per NephroSys request we will hash emails and provide a lookup only to their security team under an MOU — Laura can you confirm accepted approach?
- Service accounts: owner = infra-ops@redwood.ai, rotation = 90 days (automated via KMS), will include last rotated timestamp in doc
- RBAC scope: we already apply least-privilege for product teams; the attached PDF highlights the 4 admin roles and which actions are admin-only.

If no blocking issues I will upload to the Drive link Stephanie created and mark files with minimal redaction where required.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@audit-consult.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: security_ops@nephrosys.com
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2/CAIQ follow-up: SCIM delta syncs & SAML admin role proof

Thanks — this looks good. A couple quick clarifications before you share: 

- For the SCIM CSV, instead of hashing emails, we'd prefer pseudonymized IDs plus a mapping file shared only over the secure channel (we can accept SHA256 hashes if you prefer).
- Please include the last 3 rotation timestamps for any service account you reference (we'll spot-check).
- On RBAC mapping PDF, could you add a one-line control objective at the top (e.g., "Admins limited to defined job titles; approval required for new admin role creation")?

If you can post everything to the Drive link and notify us when it is gated for NephroSys sec-ops, we'll pull artifacts into our tracker.

-Morgan

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@audit-consult.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 15:40:00 -07:00

Morgan — all items uploaded and gated for NephroSys sec-ops. Drive link (view + download for specified emails): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/NephroSys/IAM-evidence-2025Q3

What we uploaded (files listed):
- scim_delta_2025Q3.csv (emails pseudonymized with SHA256; mapping file shared to NephroSys TLS endpoint)

Laura confirmed the redaction approach and we have an MOU for the mapping file exchange. Rishi — thanks for pulling the exports. Morgan — let me know if you need anything else or if NephroSys wants us to add additional audit log slices (we can provide token issuance logs for a 7-day window).

Best,
-Stephanie
